title: Elastic achieves ISO/IEC 42001 certification
summary: Elastic has achieved ISO/IEC 42001 certification, the international standard for AI management systems. See what this means for Elastic Agent Builder, Elastic AI Agent, and the Elastic Inference Service, and how to request a copy of the certificate.

title: Scaling cyber protection for US critical infrastructure: How Elastic supports the Community Cyber Resilience Foundation
summary: Elastic powers critical cybersecurity capabilities within the Dragos Platform, helping the new Community Cyber Resilience Foundation protect under-resourced US water, electric, and natural gas utilities from cyber threats.
